subject: Re: PathMNIST source-parent mapping question
quoted_question: Does the published PathMNIST source-image mapping preserve enough information to reconstruct the NCT-CRC-HE-100K slide or patient parent for every patch? If there is a recommended mapping file or grouping field beyond the source-image CSV in the MedMNIST repository, could you point me to it?
response_text:
Hi Aditya,

Thanks for reaching out!

We provide a mapping CSV that links each PathMNIST sample to its original patch ID:
https://github.com/MedMNIST/MedMNIST/issues/49

We followed the original dataset's train/test separation, so we do not expect leakage into the independent test set. You can find more details in our paper.

For the corresponding slide/patient IDs, you may want to contact the original NCT-CRC-HE-100K authors to check whether this information is available.

Best,
Jiancheng (JC)
direct_claims: The published CSV links each PathMNIST sample to its original patch ID.
MedMNIST followed the original dataset's train/test separation.
The original NCT-CRC-HE-100K authors are the suggested contact for slide or patient IDs.
not_supplied: a slide identifier for each patch
a patient identifier for each patch
a complete parent mapping for the PathMNIST train and validation populations
handling_note: This retained reply is candidate provenance evidence. It does not directly edit an authority registry, grant model-use purpose, or admit PathMNIST.
